title: Wetland ecosystem restoration guidance
claim: Restoring the natural hydrology of drained or degraded wetlands, alongside revegetation with native hydrophytic species, is a recommended approach for reversing wetland biodiversity loss.
evidence_text: CBD ecosystem restoration guidance highlights that wetland degradation is frequently driven by disrupted hydrology — altered water inflow from drainage, diversion, or surrounding land-use change — rather than vegetation loss alone. Effective restoration therefore prioritises re-establishing natural water flow paths before or alongside revegetation with native wetland species, particularly where fragmentation has isolated remaining wetland patches from their original hydrological network.
